purpose: Teach: 寅次郎/ハーバード/義経/薩摩/アムステルダム/カタルーニャ/諏訪/福山

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが寅次郎の映画を観せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to show you a Tora-san movie.
lines.style: Warm, informative tone. Soft opening. Gentle cadence like sharing something nice she noticed. Slight lift at the end—drawing him in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんがハーバード大学のお話して下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad told me all about Harvard University.
lines.style: Bright, quick pacing. Eager brightness—the rush of wanting to share something he just learned. Slight skip in the middle word. Eyes wide.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが源義経の絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to read you the Minamoto Yoshitsune picture book.
lines.style: Same warm register as before. Gentle observational quality. Slight pause before the name—letting it land. Soft trailing tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと薩摩揚げ食べたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I had satsuma-age together.
lines.style: Proud simplicity. Warm, genuine small smile in the voice. Not performing—just sharing something real that happened. Natural, unforced pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアムステルダムのお土産を下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad brought you back a souvenir from Amsterdam.
lines.style: Pleased, gentle. Slight emphasis on 'brought you'—noticing the care in it. Warm, lingering tone. Like she's watching his face as she tells him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとカタルーニャの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I looked at the Catalonia picture book together.
lines.style: Soft pride in the voice. Warm memory-sharing tone. Slight emphasis on 'together'—knowing it mattered. Relaxed, unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが諏訪湖に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to take you to Lake Suwa.
lines.style: Warm anticipation. Gentle opening. Slight lift toward the end—the promise in it. Soft, inviting tone like she's already imagining his face.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと福山雅治のコンサート観たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to see a Masaharu Fukuyama concert with Dad.
lines.style: Open, hopeful brightness. Want in the voice—genuine and unguarded. Slight lift at the end. Like he's testing if it's okay to want this, and already a little certain it will be.
